definition: the blue color, like a clear sky
description: Inside a wooden aviary with wire mesh walls in a green wood, a young woman in a green T-shirt and a baseball cap holds a large peacock in her arms and laughs. The bird's deep blue neck and chest fill most of the frame, its crest standing up on its head and its scaly clawed feet dangling against her arm. It leans its head in towards her face, and at the end stretches its long blue neck straight towards the camera until the shining blue feathers fill the shot.
transcript: Sometimes you just gotta add them to your video. Ready? See? They just, you know.
